messages.title: New: Xbox 360/OG playtime tracking
messages.body:
Xbox doesn't record how long you play Xbox 360/Original games, so PixelShelf now times them for you.
 Turn on Xbox 360 Tracking in Recently Played and your sessions are timed automatically, with a notification when tracking starts and when it's done. Prefer to do it yourself? Tap + on any Xbox 360/OG game to log your time by hand.

messages.title: V1.6.0 Update Live
messages.body:
• New feature: Xbox/Steam Playtime and recently played. Requires linking. Found in Now Playing
• New Feature: Xbox Mythic Achievement tracking. Ability to filter and keep track of Xbox games with Mythic status. 
• New Feature: New Share cards in both Stats and the new playtime section.
• New Feature: Ability to import from spreadsheets.
